name: latent_whorl
theme: a detective's office at midnight, a brass banker's lamp over a dusted whisky tumbler — the dive drops onto the glass into the latent print's never-crossing ridge maze, down the ridge canyons to the salt crystals standing on the crests, and folds out where that field of lit salt becomes the city lights jeweled across a rain-beaded pane, falling home through one lit window to the desk

registers.name: desk_lamplight
registers.palette: aged brass and candle amber on deep plum dark
registers.scene: a broad wooden desk top at midnight under a brass banker's lamp, its curved green glass throwing a warm amber pool over the desk, typed papers strewn across the pool and a buff card folder open among them, a heavy cut-glass tumbler standing in the light with grey fingerprint dust worked over its side, a black dial telephone and a small brass tray at the edge of the light, deep plum darkness in the room beyond the pool, empty, no one present, seen from just above the desk

registers.name: print_field
registers.palette: pale grey dust and brass sheen on plum-black glass
registers.scene: a wide field of fine pale ridge lines laid across dark glass, hundreds of dust-grey curves running in long parallel sweeps and never once crossing, the same arc shape repeating over and over across the whole field, the curves wound tight around one small spiral core and splitting apart at wedge-shaped forks where three families of ridges meet, thin plum-black troughs between every ridge, low brass lamplight raking across the field from one side, seen from straight above
registers.loop_target: a wide field of pale grey ridge lines across dark glass, long never-crossing parallel curves wound around one small spiral core, low brass lamplight raking from one side, seen from straight above

registers.name: ridge_canyons
registers.palette: hot brass crest light over plum-black canyon depth
registers.scene: deep canyons winding between tall rounded ridge walls, the walls banked in fine flaking scales and pitted with rows of round dark pores along every crest, drifts of pale grey dust packed into the canyon floors, small white salt grains standing in clusters all along the crest tops, hot brass light on the upper walls and plum-black depth down in the troughs

registers.name: salt_stars
registers.palette: cold white sparks scattered on deep plum dark
registers.scene: hundreds of hard white salt cubes scattered across a dark crest, every cube and stepped cluster of cubes holding one hot amber spark of lamplight on its corner, wide plum-black gaps between them, a faint brass haze lying low over the whole field

registers.name: rain_pane
registers.palette: amber streetlight and cold plum night
registers.scene: a night city spread out below beyond a rain-beaded pane, hundreds of amber street lamps and lit windows scattered across dark blocks and slick wet streets, long amber streaks laid down the roadways, water beads standing over the whole pane with a point of amber light in each, deep plum cloud banked low over the skyline

music_theme: midnight noir — brushed drums and a walking upright bass under a muted trumpet line, one cold shimmering swell landing on the salt-to-city fold
